# enstow

> A secret-aware dotfile manager combining GNU stow symlinking with seamless sops and age decryption.

enstow manages modular dotfile packages across platforms with native symlink tracking and in-memory decryption for secret files (e.g., `.age` and `.sops.yaml`) plus `.tmpl` template rendering. Plaintext secret targets are written with strict permissions (`0600`) without ever storing plaintext secrets in version control.

- [Full Context (llms-full.txt)](llms-full.txt): Single-file compiled documentation and architecture reference for LLMs.

## Core Modules

- [CLI Definition](src/cli.rs): Clap-based CLI structure, command routing, subcommands, arguments, and dynamic shell completions.
- [Stow Engine](src/stow.rs): Dotfile scanning, file action planning, symlink creation, collision handling, backups, adopt mode, and status auditing.
- [Cryptographic Engine](src/crypto.rs): Secret detection, in-memory age and sops decryption, secure file creation (0600), encryption, interactive editing, and rekeying.
- [Diff Engine](src/diff.rs): Unified diff generation between dotfiles and destination targets with secret masking support.
- [Doctor Diagnostics](src/doctor.rs): System health checks covering package collisions, symlink health, secret permissions, decryption prerequisites, and secret leak scanning.
- [Onboarding Engine](src/init.rs): Machine bootstrap flow (`enstow init`) for cloning repositories, detecting host/profile filters, verifying keys, and applying packages.
- [Self-Updater](src/update.rs): GitHub Releases binary updater (`enstow self-update` / `update`).
- [Lifecycle Hooks](src/hook.rs): Pre- and post-apply and unstow lifecycle hook execution with contextual environment variables.
- [Configuration Engine](src/config.rs): Hierarchical configuration parser for TOML, YAML, and JSON with profile, condition filter, permission, and hook support.
- [Error Types](src/error.rs): Custom domain error definitions covering I/O, encryption, decryption, symlink, hook, and configuration failures.
- [Library Root](src/lib.rs): Public module declarations and API surface.
- [Main Entry](src/main.rs): Main executable entry point with tracing initialization, configuration merging, and subcommand dispatch.

## CLI Commands

- [Init](docs/usage.md#bootstrapping-a-new-machine-enstow-init): Bootstrap dotfile repository onboarding: clone, detect host/profile, check keys, and apply.
- [Add](docs/usage.md#ingesting-dotfiles-enstow-add): Ingest an existing machine dotfile into a package as a symlink or encrypted secret.
- [Apply](docs/usage.md#applying-dotfiles-enstow-apply): Symlink regular dotfiles and decrypt secret files into target directories (alias: `sync`).
- [Restow](docs/usage.md#restowing-packages-enstow-restow): Re-apply dotfiles, pruning stale links and re-decrypting modified secrets.
- [Unstow](docs/usage.md#unstowing-scrubbing-dotfiles-enstow-unstow-scrub): Cleanly remove symlinks and decrypted secret target files with optional secure shredding (`--shred`).
- [Scrub](docs/usage.md#unstowing-scrubbing-dotfiles-enstow-unstow-scrub): Securely zeroize and delete decrypted secret files and symlinks.
- [Status](docs/usage.md#inspecting-status-enstow-status): Inspect sync, missing, conflict, modified drift, and unverified states with optional JSON output.
- [Diff](docs/usage.md#inspecting-diffs-enstow-diff): Show unified diff between package dotfiles and target destination with optional secret masking and JSON output.
- [Doctor](docs/usage.md#system-diagnostics-enstow-doctor): Audit system health, secret hygiene, permissions, and symlinks (alias: `lint`).
- [Encrypt](docs/secrets.md#encrypting-secrets-enstow-encrypt): Encrypt dotfile secrets to recipient age public keys, SSH keys, identity key files, or passphrase.
- [Decrypt](docs/secrets.md#decrypting-secrets-enstow-decrypt): Decrypt an age or sops encrypted secret dotfile to stdout or file.
- [Edit](docs/secrets.md#editing-secrets-enstow-edit): Decrypt, edit in temporary memory or editor, and re-encrypt age secret files safely.
- [Rekey](docs/secrets.md#rekeying-secrets-enstow-rekey): Re-encrypt age secrets across packages with updated recipient public keys.
- [Completions](docs/installation.md#shell-completions): Generate dynamic or static shell completion scripts for Bash, Zsh, Fish, PowerShell, and Elvish.
- [Man](docs/installation.md#man-page): Output UNIX roff format man page to stdout.
- [Self-Update](docs/installation.md#github-releases-self-update): Update enstow in-place from GitHub Releases (alias: `update`).

## Build and Quality Gates

- [Cargo Manifest](Cargo.toml): Package configuration, dependencies (`clap`, `age`, `walkdir`, `serde`, `tempfile`, `similar`, `self_update`), Debian packaging metadata, and release profiles.
- [Taskfile Automation](Taskfile.yml): Standard tasks for cross-compiling, testing, clippy linting, formatting, coverage, Zensical docs, and releases.
- [Python Docs Environment](pyproject.toml): Python environment (`zensical>=0.0.45`) for building the static documentation site via `uv`.
- [Zensical Configuration](zensical.toml): Zensical static documentation site configuration, theme, plugins, extensions, and navigation.
- [CI Pipeline](.github/workflows/ci.yml): GitHub Actions automated test, lint, and cross-platform verification matrix.
- [Docs Deployment](.github/workflows/docs.yml): GitHub Pages deployment workflow for the Zensical documentation site.
